title: The Second Bakery
author: Yara Kavanagh
blurb: Ivo Almeida, a ghostwriter secretly penning a rival's memoirs, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must let someone stay after the last train leaves before the festival ends.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
